entities.name: PMID:37980513
observations: Systematic review of pediatric spondylodiscitis reports radiographic findings including disc narrowing, reduced lumbar lordosis, and adjacent endplate irregularity or erosion; it does not establish a precise chronology.

entities.name: Pediatric discitis radiograph progression
observations: The answer-choice-consistent classic sequence is loss of normal lumbar lordosis, followed by disc-space narrowing and then endplate erosion; retrieved reviews confirm these findings but do not independently establish the exact chronology.

entities.name: HBV markers and cirrhosis
observations: In a retrospective cohort of 119 non-Asian women with chronic HBV, historical/current HBV DNA and qHBsAg were not independent predictors of elastography-defined F3–F4; only 14 participants met the outcome, limiting precision.
Historical HBV DNA RR 0.34 (95% CI 0.05–2.44); qHBsAg >1,000 IU/mL RR 0.35 (95% CI 0.11–1.11). Outcome was prevalent LSM-defined advanced fibrosis/cirrhosis, not biopsy-confirmed cirrhosis.
